2) Decompensated heart failure with preserved ejection fraction.

The patient presented with five days of cough, fever and breathlessness. Chest imaging showed right lower lobe consolidation and mild pulmonary congestion. She was treated with oral amoxicillin and a short course of intravenous furosemide. Her oxygen requirement settled by the fourth day and she walked unaided on the ward by the sixth.
